instructions: Follow AGENTS.md. Keep this repository's existing layout. Generated packaging/coverage output uses Basaltwater's guarded remover; artifacts mix development evidence and need agent review.

rules.name: generated-output
rules.instructions: Confirm no packaging, coverage or release work needs these outputs. clean-generated previews by default and refuses tracked files, active use, unsafe paths or incomplete inventory. Apply needs repository-root writes to isolate selected directories before disposal; never grant the whole home.

rules.name: development-evidence
rules.instructions: Keep raw logs, screenshots and videos in private storage outside Git or explicitly ignored artifact directories. Review selected evidence for credentials, personal infrastructure, business/customer information and user data before proposing tracked summaries or sanitized artifacts. Use repository-relative provenance, capture date, commit, caption and checksum; keep original private paths in local evidence only. Preserve release and unfinished-work evidence; delete only explicitly approved remnants after archive verification.
